description: A stereo sample looper: it plays one WAV file round and round, free running or stretched to fit a set number of bars against a clock

params.text: Sets how many bars the sample counts as, 1 to 24; at zero the count comes from the tempo read out of the filename, falling back to four bars
Sets the tempo the sample counts as, up to 300 BPM; at zero the tempo comes from the filename, falling back to 120 BPM
Shifts the playback speed by up to an octave either way, halving it at one end and doubling it at the other
Locks the playback speed to the clock so the sample fills the set number of bars; it comes up on
Plays the sample backwards; the change takes effect at the next bar boundary and the playhead snaps to that boundary
Sends the sample to the mono cue output and silences the main outputs; switching back fades the main outputs in over 1 second
Sends playback back to the start. With the clock switch on and a cable at CLK it takes effect on the next quarter-note pulse, otherwise at once
Moves the loop start point in eighths of the whole sample, 1 to 8; a change takes effect at the end of the current pass

inputs.text: One pulse per quarter note. Its tempo is measured and used to stretch the sample across the set number of bars
A rising edge above 1V sends playback back to the start, on the same terms as the RESET button
Shifts the playback speed: 5V raises it by an octave and -5V lowers it by one
Offsets BARS by 2.4 bars per volt, holding the total between 1 and 24 bars
Offsets BPM by 30 BPM per volt, holding the total between 0 and 300 BPM
Offsets SHIFT by 0.8 steps per volt, holding the total between 1 and 8
Above 1V it flips the REV switch over, so the sample runs the opposite way to whatever the switch shows

outputs.text: The left channel of the sample, ±5V; silent while CUE is on
The right channel of the sample, ±5V; silent while CUE is on
The two channels summed to mono, carried here only while CUE is on and silent the rest of the time

notes: nothing plays until a file is loaded. Right-click the module and choose Load WAV...
the tempo is read out of the filename and nothing else: the digits immediately before the letters bpm are taken as the tempo, and the bar count is worked out from that
the loaded file is embedded in the patch when the patch is saved, so it reopens without the original file, at the cost of a larger patch
menu: Load WAV... — opens a file chooser and loads the chosen WAV into the module
1 PPQN (Submit standard) — reads each pulse at CLK as one quarter note
4 PPQN (compatibility) — reads four pulses at CLK as one quarter note

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
